Nice but expensive
Aug 2025 • Family
Don Cipriani’s was good - we had very attentive service and the vibe is nice albeit a bit cliche. The food was decent - nothing earth shattering but not bad either. Solid pizza, well cooked pasta, nice appetisers. Prices are very high though - and while I can appreciate some ingredients need to be imported, this is also a choice (ie Vietnam has some great beef, doesn’t need to be imported). As with many high end places in Vietnam it does seem outrageous that local sparkling water isn’t available. Importing water is just ridiculous from an environmental perspective. 

So if you want a decent, pricey Italian in a great resort this ticks the boxes.

Fantastic Birthday Dinner
Apr 2024 • Family
We celebrated my mothers 80th birthday at Don Cipriani and were very satisfied. 

The F&B Manager of the Furama Resort had put together a special Vietnamese birthday menu which we enjoyed at the Italian outlet as the setting is more cozy than the main hotel restaurant.

The food was excellent with amazing flavours and a well thought out sequence. The service by Ms. Phuong was simply outstanding. She is very well trained and charming at the same time. She ensured that we had the best possible experience.

While I cannot comment on the Italian fare at this restaurant, the exceptionally high standard of service, the great Vietnamese cuisine and the cozy setting easily justify a five star rating.
